notes:
Lead profile: Pinegrove Sprout AI is an SMB e-commerce personalization shop building a lightweight chat+recommendation assistant for product pages and customer support. Inbound self-serve signup converted to trial last week. They are public-cloud-first and want Hosted API (self-serve).

Initial problem: several devs reported inconsistent latency — US users fine, EU users seeing 200-600ms extra per request and occasional timeouts from browser clients. Team sent logs showing higher p99 from eu-west region. They use short-lived fetches from client (client-side direct call without region pinning).

Key quotes from call: "We saw nice quality but some sessions freeze — customers churn if response > 2s." — Head of Eng.

Technical notes / constraints:
- Workloads: chat-style support flows (few-shot prompts) + embedding lookups for recommendations (batch embeddings for catalog).
- Latency target: p95 < 800ms for chat completions in EU, ideally <500ms in the US.
- Throughput: low to medium, ~30-120 reqs/min during peaks.
- Cost sensitivity: high — evaluating token controls and prompt truncation.
- Model preference: open Llama-family variants or efficient instruction-tuned models; will accept smaller quantized variants if quality maintained.
- Routing needs: prefer regional endpoints to reduce RTT; fallback to US if EU capacity degraded.
- Security: require SSO (SAML) for console access and basic audit logs; data residency not required now.

Timeline / recent activities:
- 2026-02-20: Self-serve signup + trial created (auto-credit applied).
- 2026-02-27: First onboarding email from Avery; scheduled intro call.
- 2026-03-03: Discovery call (ff_20260303_3621) — latency reports surfaced; SE assigned (Maya).
- 2026-03-05: Devs shared p99 traces and client logs (Gmail thread).
- 2026-03-09: Internal triage — SE reproduced higher RTT when using default global endpoint from EU VMs.
- 2026-03-10: Demo of region pinning and timeout tuning on staging; agreed to run a 48h region comparison test.

Suggested immediate actions taken / recommended by SE:
- Region choice: Recommend EU-specific endpoint (eu-1) for EU traffic; document link to region endpoints included in follow-up drive doc.
- Timeouts: Advise client-side connect timeout 1.5s, read timeout 3.5s; server retry with exponential backoff and idempotency tokens for safe retries.
- Prompt length guidance: Provide prompt template to reduce token usage — remove repetitive system preamble on each turn, push static context to embeddings + retrieval, and limit examples in few-shot to 2-3 concise samples.
- Batching: For embeddings, batch catalog uploads and use async embedding ingestion to avoid spikes.
- Monitoring: Enable per-route token/latency dashboard in Redwood Console and set alert at p95 > 1s for EU route.
- Fallbacks: Configure routing policy to fallback to compatible smaller model in case of regional overload.

Open items / blockers:
- Dev team needs a short region test script from SE to run from EU infra (requested).
- They want a one-pager that maps prompt length -> cost/latency tradeoffs (Avery to deliver).
- Legal asked for brief on audit logs retention options (drive doc link shared).

Next steps agreed:
- 03/12: SE to share region test script + quick prompt trimming checklist (done).
- 03/12-03/14: Pinegrove runs 48h region comparison test and returns summarized p95/p99 numbers.
- 03/16: 30m follow-up to review results and discuss Dedicated vs Hosted if EU p99 remains high.

Sales notes / tone: Warm inbound, technical champion (lead dev) engaged, cost-sensitive but motivated by UX improvements. Likely to convert to paid hosted plan if EU latency resolves with recommended tuning.
